protocol: V6 independent gross-import channels and response-only mechanism audit v1
interpretation: Model-conditional intervention effects, not empirically identified causal effects or probability confidence intervals.

mechanism_cases.question: Remove emissions-error feedback only; preserve exogenous carbon-price drift and all other decisions.
Keep initial useful-service carrier shares before fuel/power requests; remove both autonomous carrier trend and relative consumer responses.
Preserve the calibrated external carrier/electrification trend; disable only relative cost and prior-shortage response.
Remove relative profit/capital-cost correction to orders; retain utilisation, shortage, curtailment and supply feedback.
Remove utilisation innovation, shortage and curtailment corrections for all investors; retain relative profit correction.
Only common recent-net-addition plus assumed retirement gross orders remain, subject to unchanged caps and budget.

Only actual new-project commissioning slots and their physical feedstock limit use a one-year lead. The native reference gross-order forecast anchor and initial pipeline remain unchanged; no same-year energy or capacity. Later realised feedback evolves naturally.
Joint removal of government, consumer and investor adaptation; keep native construction, initial stocks, resources and capital constraints.
Same-2020-calibration-period external recent-increment useful-service and electricity expectations. Assets are never overwritten by trend targets; common physical and capital clearing remains.

Stronger information-current forward baseline: useful-service and electricity increments use observations through the initial year 2024, including 2021-24; 2025 is excluded. Shared initial states, investment orders, capital, construction and supply constraints remain physical.
Remove the positive gross coal channel only; same domestic retention map, domestic assets, initial stocks, queues and rules.
Remove coal gross channel and remap domestic retention to C/P, preserving total base-year supply; composition diagnostic.

joint_design.boundary: Equal design weights are not probabilities. Report min/median/max over these 48 declared baseline cases only; no coverage or percentile confidence claim. All parameters vary jointly; rank associations are descriptive and do not allocate causal variance. 2025 is not used for selection.

comparisons.not_additive: Single switch effects overlap and must not be added; the joint alternative measures the combined model effect.
comparisons.null_and_reverse_results: Preserve all cases, including no-effect and directionally adverse effects. A lower emissions total is never counted as improvement without reporting delivered service.

limitations: Four aggregate service carrier groups are not observed industrial/transport sectors.
No hourly-to-annual endogenous feedback is newly claimed.
Minimum one-year construction is an engineering counterfactual, not zero lag and not a feasible national construction policy.
Joint design ranges are declared engineering ranges, not estimated parameter distributions.
Gross import calorific references and the domestic retention map are disclosed engineering mappings; retained production plus gross imports equals observed 2024 use.
No complete origin-year gross-trade panel is available for earlier rolling origins; inherited V5 expectations validation is kept distinct from V6 import-account validation.

profit_rule.market_price_status: Engineering initial-state assumption, not observed market-price estimate
profit_rule.reference: Initial observed capacity factors, initial engineering costs, 100 CNY/t initial carbon price and 450 CNY/MWh initial market state; fixed throughout each trajectory.
profit_rule.signal: (realised annual profit minus current capacity times initial reference profit/GW)/(current capacity times 8% initial capital cost), denominator floor 1 million CNY
profit_rule.order_multiplier: clip(1+0.25 signal,0,2), all original capital, rate, feedstock and construction constraints retained
profit_rule.legacy: Named legacy_v4 rule tested for exact four-scenario parity.

scarcity_price_sensitivity.scope: Smooth price equals marginal cost plus the nonnegative difference to tier times shortfall_fraction/(shortfall_fraction+0.01). Step reproduces the legacy 1e-6 TWh switch.

import_conversion_sensitivity.amendment_reason: Joint -10% reference violates domestic retained-supply <= observed domestic production for oil/gas. Four original low-reference attempts preserved and excluded. Revised -2% and +10% are explicit engineering diagnostics, not probability intervals or a confirmatory distribution.
import_conversion_sensitivity.scope: Both feasible reference multipliers remap retention so base-year supply remains observed C. Observed domestic P and C are fixed. Require 0<=retention<=1.

factorial_consumer_disabled: exogenous_trend: historical autonomous carrier trend retained; price/shortage responses disabled
legacy_frozen_share_factorial: Separate 32-cell diagnostic; consumer-disabled freezes initial shares and therefore removes external trend as well as responses
